title: FastByDate route lacks direct regression coverage
reasoning: The owned route exposes /fasts/by-date/ through FastByDateView, but the linked fast view tests import and exercise FastListView and FastByFeastDateView only. The analogous by-feast-date endpoint has coverage for authenticated and unauthenticated scoping, missing date, invalid date format, timezone, caching, different church, and annotations, while the by-date route has no comparable evidence in the included tests. That leaves a user-input date route without regression coverage for its API contract and authorization/church filtering behavior.
recommendation: Add direct tests for FastByDateView covering at least successful authenticated lookup, unauthenticated lookup with church_id, missing date, invalid date format, timezone handling, no matches, and cross-church isolation.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The included tests cover FastListView and FastByFeastDateView behavior, but no included test imports FastByDateView or sends a request to /fasts/by-date/.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a FastByDateViewTest class in hub/tests/test_fast_views.py mirroring the FastByFeastDateViewTest setup, using /api/fasts/by-date/ and asserting date filtering, validation errors, and church scoping.
minimumFixScope: Test-only change in hub/tests/test_fast_views.py for FastByDateView.
